question: Does any conversation surface still render the bare Untitled Conversation fallback (a kept row with no server title and no transcript text in its payload)? The target is zero; age buckets separate legacy rows from new regressions.
zero_policy: Zero is the goal: the server titles every kept row and the app falls back to transcript text. Zero is only meaningful alongside conversation-list traffic in the same namespace/build; the event fires at most once per conversation per app session.
